IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert - sustained KV namespace hit-rate drop for customer Valor (vpc-valor, dedicated pool dpool-8). Observed 6x increase in backend misses over 10m. thread:2279504321
Alice (oncall): acked. I'm paged and taking lead. starting timeline and impact assessment.
Valor-ops (customer): seeing ~30-40% of requests returning degraded latencies on our side. Some 500s from the inference gateway.
Matt (sre): logs show a sharp rise in set/evict operations from a single tenant namespace shard: namespace=valor-main-usr, ~20k evictions/min starting 2279504100. suspected cache pollution.
Jordan (eng-ml): is this correlated with a model rollout or large batch write from Valor?
Valor-ops (customer): we deployed a background reindex job around 2279504000 that touches user embeddings. Could be related.
Lina (eng-runtime): confirmed scheduling changes for dpool-8 earlier today but nothing that should change KV behavior. collecting KV metrics now (hitrate by prefix, evictions, ttl expiries).
Alice (oncall): immediate mitigations we can try: 1) throttle/restrict reindex job at customer side, 2) disable namespace-level prefetch for valor-main-usr, 3) enable tenant-isolation mode to stop cross-tenant pollution. Which do we want first?
Sam (product): customer prefers quick fix without downtime. suggest try disabling prefetch + apply temporary namespace write rate limit.
Matt (sre): created a temporary rate limit rule: `rate_limit:create --tenant valor --namespace valor-main-usr --writes-per-second 50` (applied to edge). will monitor.
DeployBot: rate limit rule applied to valor-main-usr by matt at 2279504523.
Jordan (eng-ml): pulling hit-rate dashboards. prefix-hitrate for valor-main-usr dropped from 92% to 28% in 10m. other namespaces unaffected. eviction churn is the driver (short TTL churn).
Lina (eng-runtime): we can flip `namespace_prefetch` off for that namespace via control API. command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/namespaces/valor-main-usr/cache/controls \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefetch": false}'
```
Alice (oncall): Lina, please apply that and confirm. Matt keep an eye on client-side write surge. Jordan collect a diff of keys with highest churn.
Lina (eng-runtime): applied prefetch=false at 2279504630. patch id cp-7721.
Valor-ops (customer): pausing the reindex job now (throttled). will report if we see improvement.
Matt (sre): after prefetch off + rate limit, observed small uptick in hit-rate to ~45% within 3m. latency tail improving. still below normal. eviction spikes reduced by ~60%.
Jordan (eng-ml): key churn report attached (in-thread): high churn prefixes: user_embeds:session_*, session_ctx:*, tmp_reindex:*. Looks like the reindex job was writing many ephemeral keys (`tmp_reindex:*`) without TTL which caused eviction of hot keys.
Alice (oncall): notes: root cause likely uncontrolled reindex keys without TTL causing cache pollution and forcing eviction of hot prefixes. Next steps: advise customer to set TTL on ephemeral write keys and enable namespacing for reindex job.
Sam (product): copy for Valor ops: recommend small producer-side fixes + our short-term protections (rate limit + prefetch off). Need plan for permanent fix and rollback timeline.
Valor-ops (customer): we'll add TTL=300s to tmp keys and re-run slowly. thanks team.
Matt (sre): implementing a short-lived guard in edge: denylist prefix pattern `tmp_reindex:*` for caching layer (cache bypass) so ephemeral keys don't evict hot payloads. applying now.
DeployBot: config update `cache-bypass:valor/tmp_reindex` applied by matt at 2279504922.
Lina (eng-runtime): after bypass, global hit-rate for valor-main-usr at ~78% and latency back to within SLOs. We're watching for regression over next 30m.
Alice (oncall): customer impact: degraded for ~18 minutes with partial request failures and elevated tail latency. No data loss reported. mitigation: prefetch disabled, write rate-limited, tmp keys bypassed, customer paused job and added TTL.
Valor-ops (customer): we see normal behavior resuming, grateful for the quick assist. will open a post-incident ticket to review reindex approach.
Jordan (eng-ml): follow-ups: 1) add guardrail in control plane to detect >X% eviction churn caused by single tenant and auto-apply tenant-isolation in read-only mode, 2) add advisory when clients create keys without TTL over threshold.
Sam (product): logging action item: schedule a short engineering design to add TTL-required linting for high-throughput ephemeral key patterns and update docs for customers on safe reindex patterns.
Alice (oncall): incident handoff to matt for postmortem and runbook update. I'll update status page and notify CS and account team.
Matt (sre): taking ownership for post-incident writeup. will include timeline, mitigations, customer steps, and code snippets for control API.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved (mitigations applied, customer confirmed) at 2279505880. severity downgraded to P1 -> monitoring.
Alice (oncall): thanks all, great coordination. closing thread after postmortem drafts and runbook updates. :tada:
